lines.en: Stomps forward with heavy steps.
Makes metallic footsteps.
Brushes robes against the stone.
Walks cautiously, taking notice of surroundings.

lines.zh: 轻声敲击石墙以确定方向。
lines.en: Taps the stone wall softly to find direction.
Moves slowly, remaining vigilant.

lines.zh: 踱步时发出轻微的金属声。
lines.en: Makes light metallic sounds while pacing.
Taps the ground with fingertips to explore.
Footsteps echo in the cave.
The pages rustle in your hand.

lines.zh: 提着油灯，拐进下一段隧道。
lines.en: Lantern in hand, he turns into the next tunnel.

lines.zh: 在岔路口停下，仔细听水声。
lines.en: He stops at the fork and listens to the water.

lines.zh: 长袍扫过地上的旧书页。
lines.en: His robe brushes old pages on the floor.

lines.zh: 用杖柄敲了敲头顶的岩层。
lines.en: He taps the ceiling with the butt of his staff.
Scans the area as if in thought.
Sways a cane gently.

lines.zh: 用手指梳理长袍的褶皱。
lines.en: Runs fingers through the folds of the robe.
Sits on a stone bench in thought.
Takes a book from the shelf.

lines.zh: 盯着书架上的一本书发呆。
lines.en: Stares at a book on the shelf.
Takes a oil lamp to light the area.
Adjusts the items on his person.
Whispers an ancient song.
Taps the desk with a finger.
He tops up the lantern with oil.

lines.zh: 在一页纸上记下你的名字。
lines.en: He writes your name on a page.
He orders the loose pages by number.

lines.zh: 数着架上的藏品，轻声念。
lines.en: He counts his collection aloud, softly.

lines.zh: 图鉴书页在我兜里，别急。
lines.en: The codex page is in my pocket. Easy.

lines.zh: 书页在我袖子里，价钱另算。
lines.en: The page is in my sleeve; the price is separate.
Nods at the player.
Signals the player to come over.
Scans the bookshelves with his eyes.

lines.zh: 目光闪烁，似乎有所发现。
lines.en: Eyes glint, as if with a discovery.

lines.zh: 手指指向某个方向示意。
lines.en: Points a finger in a direction.
Stares at the item in the player’s hand.
Scans the player with his eyes.

lines.zh: 用眼神评估玩家的实力。
lines.en: Assesses the player with his eyes.
Half his face appears from behind a shelf.

lines.zh: 他推了推眼镜，看清了你。
lines.en: He pushes up his glasses and makes you out.

lines.zh: 抬手指了指你脚边的书页。
lines.en: He points at the page by your feet.
He is sizing up your pack.

lines.zh: 灯影里，他的目光没有移开。
lines.en: In the lantern light, his gaze does not shift.

lines.zh: 他朝你伸出手，掌心朝上。
lines.en: He holds out a hand, palm up.
He stands a long while without a word.

lines.zh: 他侧过身，让出深处的路。
lines.en: He steps aside, opening the way deeper.

lines.zh: 他看你的眼神，像在估价。
lines.en: He looks at you the way one appraises goods.
Some of my books are damaged...
I need to rest...
My glasses are broken...
Stop scaring me...
My notes are scattered...
My ink is gone...
I need a cup of tea...
My hand is hurt...
My foot is hurt...

lines.zh: 我的图鉴书页被血浸了。
lines.en: Blood has soaked the pages of my catalog.

lines.zh: 这本图鉴，或许能说服你！
lines.en: This book might tempt you.
Come, see my treasures.
The book is in front of you.
Don't miss my treasures.

lines.zh: 你从未见过如此珍稀的宝物！
lines.en: You've never seen such rare treasures!

lines.zh: 这本图鉴记录了我的藏品！
lines.en: This book records my collection.
These treasures are worth your attention.
Look at my collection.

lines.zh: 这本图鉴，你一定会喜欢！
lines.en: You'll like this book.
My collection is unique.
Don't touch my treasures!
Stop! Or you'll regret it!
Stay out of my territory!
My treasures are not to be touched!
Back off! Or face the consequences!
Leave my treasures alone!
These treasures are off-limits!
Don't touch! Or you'll regret it!
My treasures are off-limits!
Step back! Or you'll get hurt!

lines.zh: 求个伴儿，一起守护宝藏！
lines.en: Need a partner to guard the treasures together.
Find a partner to share the treasures.
Need a helper to guard together!
Find a partner to guard the treasures together.
Need a companion to guard together!

lines.zh: 找个伴儿，共享宝藏之乐！
lines.en: Find a partner to share the joy of the treasures!
Need a partner to keep the secret together!

lines.zh: 找个伴儿，共享宝藏之旅！
lines.en: Find a partner to share the journey of the treasures!
Need a partner to share the time!

lines.zh: 找个伴儿，共守宝藏之秘！
lines.en: Find a partner to keep the secrets of the treasures!

lines.zh: 拿起书页，你闻到了墨水的香味。
lines.en: The ink's scent lingers as you pick up the page.

lines.zh: 翻动书页，仿佛能听到知识的呼吸。
lines.en: The page turns, as if the knowledge breathes.

lines.zh: 这本古旧的书，藏着无数秘密。
lines.en: This old book holds countless secrets.

lines.zh: 你感受到了书中蕴含的智慧。
lines.en: Wisdom radiates from the book.

lines.zh: 书页似乎在向你讲述故事。
lines.en: The page seems to tell a story.

lines.zh: 翻阅这些纸页，你仿佛穿越时空。
lines.en: Turning the pages, you seem to travel through time.
This is a page from the curator's collection.
The page bears the marks of time.

lines.zh: 你打开了一个知识的宝库。
lines.en: You've opened a treasure of knowledge.

lines.zh: 馆长用知识编织了这本图书。
lines.en: The curator wove this book with knowledge.

lines.zh: 你成了他的目标，馆长的视线锁定你。
lines.en: You've become his target, the curator locks onto you.

lines.zh: 馆长的注意力转向你，准备交易。
lines.en: The curator's attention turns to you, ready to trade.

lines.zh: 你被馆长盯上了，他要找你聊聊。
lines.en: The curator is focusing on you, wanting to chat.

lines.zh: 馆长注意到了你，他有东西要交易。
lines.en: The curator noticed you, he has something to trade.

lines.zh: 馆长盯上你了，他想看看你有没有合适的商品。
lines.en: The curator is on you, looking for something to trade.

lines.zh: 馆长注意到了你，准备开始对话。
lines.en: The curator is focusing on you, ready to converse.

lines.zh: 你被馆长盯上了，他想交易些东西。
lines.en: The curator is locking onto you, wanting to trade.

lines.zh: 馆长盯上了你，他有话想说。
lines.en: The curator is focusing on you, he has something to say.

lines.zh: 馆长注意到了你，准备开始交易。
lines.en: The curator is focusing on you, ready to trade.

lines.zh: 你被馆长盯上了，他想查看你的货物。
lines.en: The curator is focusing on you, wanting to check your goods.

lines.zh: 你成了他的目标，馆长开始行动。
lines.en: You've become his target, the curator acts.

lines.zh: 馆长瞄准了你，准备交易。
lines.en: The curator is targeting you, ready to trade.

lines.zh: 馆长锁定目标，准备进行交易。
lines.en: The curator locks on, ready to trade.

lines.zh: 馆长开始瞄准你，准备交易。
lines.en: The curator targets you, ready to trade.

lines.zh: 馆长瞄准你，准备开始对话。
lines.en: The curator targets you, ready to converse.

lines.zh: 馆长锁定目标，准备开始交易。
lines.en: The curator locks on, ready to trade.

lines.zh: 馆长瞄准目标，准备进行交易。
lines.en: The curator targets, ready to trade.

lines.zh: 馆长锁定目标，准备开始对话。
lines.en: The curator locks on, ready to converse.
He closes the book and rises slowly.

lines.zh: 他放下灯，往前迈了一步。
lines.en: He sets down the lantern and takes a step forward.
Awaken the silence with ashes!
Remember this lesson!

lines.zh: 藏在书籍中，藏在灵魂里！
lines.en: Hidden in books, hidden in the soul!
Let knowledge be your weapon!
You cannot defeat knowledge!
Knowledge is power!
Wrath from the soul!
Judgment by knowledge!
The power of knowledge seals you!
The light of knowledge blinds you!
A new page awaits!
Welcome to the Library of Knowledge!
Seek the wisdom of the unknown!
Hidden in the pages!
Seek the treasures of knowledge!
The light of wisdom guides you!
Secrets await in the books!
The peace of the library is broken!
Spirits within the books yearn for freedom!
Seek the truth of knowledge!
Around the bend, the lantern lights first.

lines.zh: 你回头，他已在暗处等候。
lines.en: You turn, and he is already waiting in the dark.
My collection is on fire...
I fell from the shelf...
My books are flooded...
My collection was exploded...

lines.zh: 箭穿过书页，钉在我的柜上。
lines.en: The arrow pierces a page and sticks in my shelf.
My wand was destroyed...

lines.zh: 馆长的书架换不了一顿饭。
lines.en: The curator's shelves can't buy one meal.

lines.zh: 雷把我洞里的书页吹散了。
lines.en: The lightning scatters the pages in my cave.
I am lost...
